No generic optimizer, autonomous self-modifying runtime, organization-wide experiment platform or product-truth mutation is required.

architectureDecisions: Create a narrow production HOW-evolution application boundary in packages/agentic-system/src/how-evolution.js. Leave the bounded self-upgrade pilot unchanged: reuse its proven pinning, independence, bounded-budget and baseline-preservation semantics, but do not stretch its BB-035-specific productionEvidence=false/generalizationEvidence=false contract into a generic optimizer.

Translate one delivered Integration-I causal reconstruction into an immutable HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING that pins the exact CausalObservationSubject/projection/evidence refs, affected domain/workload, observed baseline policy/strategy and one bounded HOW axis. The finding is evidence only: it cannot generate a candidate, evaluate, promote, rollback or mutate product truth.

Define HOW_EVOLUTION_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL v1 before candidate evaluation. It pins the fixed semantic WHAT/acceptance subject, finding, exact baseline and candidate strategy/config refs+digests, candidate producer identity, evaluator descriptor/policy, scenario-set version+digest, metric policy+thresholds, replay/budget parameters, evidence snapshot and expected ExecutionPolicyHead tuple. Baseline and candidate must differ only in declared HOW surfaces.

Partition protocol cases into finding-trigger cases, regression controls and evaluator-owned recorded holdout controls. The candidate producer may use trigger/development evidence but cannot replace or rewrite the holdout set after the protocol is fixed. Baseline and candidate run the identical pinned case membership; missing cases, evaluator errors or missing required measurements are INCONCLUSIVE rather than pass.

Evaluate baseline and candidate as paired per-case runs before aggregation. Hard gates are no newly failing product/acceptance critical case, full policy/authority compliance, complete required evidence/currentness and recovery non-regression. A predeclared primary value metric must meet minEffect on heldout cases; cost/token and latency budgets are pinned constraints or tie-breakers. Aggregate improvement can never hide a critical-case regression.

Add packages/agentic-system/src/how-evolution-jev-adapter.js as an Evaluator port implementation patterned after the trusted outer Blackboard adapter: exact model/policy identity, canonical request hash, typed choice outcomes, response identity, bounded evidence, transport/model mismatch failure and no mutation methods. Provider credentials remain process/CI secrets and are never persisted in protocol or evidence artifacts.

Use Core trust-boundary and verification-assessment primitives for evaluator/evidence authority. Implement HOW-specific freshness/currentness checks against the protocol's semantic-subject digest, evaluator-policy digest, scenario-set digest, evidence-snapshot digest and exact expected ExecutionPolicyHead; do not force the state-specific evaluation-freshness helper into a generic abstraction where its candidate-memory semantics do not fit.

A successful evaluation can create only HOW_EVOLUTION_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL. Independent promotion authority must be distinct from candidate producer and evaluator, re-resolve every pinned artifact, prove the current ExecutionPolicyHead still equals the evaluated baseline tuple, then invoke the existing createDomainExecutionPolicyPublisher. That publisher already verifies publisher authority, requires generation+1 and CAS-fences the current head; a race therefore fails closed.

Promotion stores a new immutable ExecutionStrategyDescriptor/EXECUTION_POLICY generation and affects only future eligible attempts. Existing ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts keep their immutable ExecutionAttemptBinding because DomainExecutionController resolves the attempt head before policy selection and recovery reuses the bound policy/strategy rather than re-resolving current policy.

Rollback uses the same independently authorized, currentness-fenced publication path with reasonKind=ROLLBACK: publish a new generation selecting the exact prior accepted strategy/policy lineage and link the rollback decision to the promotion/evaluation it reverses. Never delete or rewrite finding, protocol, run, evaluation, proposal, decision, policy or strategy history.

Persist only compact authority/current-head data in mutable heads. HOW findings, protocols, paired run results, Jev receipts, evaluations, proposals and promotion/rollback decisions are immutable artifacts addressed by exact ref+digest through an injected artifact-store port; large run/evidence bodies remain external to heads so fresh-process reconstruction and deterministic replay do not depend on conversation/process memory.

expectedFromDependencies: BB-058 implementation-result and independent ACCEPT judgment

implementationSlices: J1 — Finding and ownership boundary: after BB-058 is DONE, bind one exact CausalReconstructionProjection into HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING; add the narrow how-evolution module and immutable artifact-store port while preserving self-upgrade-pilot as a bounded legacy pilot.

J2 — Fixed experiment protocol: implement HOW_EVOLUTION_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL v1 with fixed WHAT/acceptance subject, baseline/candidate HOW pins, producer/evaluator identities, trigger/regression/holdout scenario digest, metric thresholds, replay/budget fields, evidence snapshot and expected policy-head tuple.

J3 — Paired evaluation + Jev adapter: run baseline/candidate over identical protocol cases, persist per-case quality/recovery/policy/cost/latency evidence, apply deterministic hard gates and call the explicit Jev evaluator port only for semantic rubric claims; persist exact request/response/model/policy receipts.

J4 — Independent promotion/currentness: produce proposal-only output on satisfied evaluation, require producer/evaluator/promoter separation, revalidate semantic/evaluator/scenario/evidence/head currentness, then call existing createDomainExecutionPolicyPublisher so generation+1 and CAS remain the sole policy-currentness mutation path.

J5 — Attempt pinning and rollback: prove pre-promotion ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts reuse their old ExecutionAttemptBinding, a new attempt resolves the new head, and rollback creates another independently authorized successor generation selecting the exact prior accepted strategy.

J6 — Fresh-process reconstruction and adversarial proof: reconstruct finding -> protocol -> paired runs -> Jev receipt -> evaluation -> proposal -> promotion/rollback decision -> policy head only from durable refs; reject moved WHAT, hidden critical regression, holdout/evaluator drift, stale head, unauthorized actor, incomplete evidence and history rewrite.

fixedSubject: scenarioSet ref/version/digest with trigger, regression and evaluator-owned holdout partitions
metricPolicy ref/digest with minEffect and max cost/token/latency regression constraints
replay policy: provider/model/config refs, stochastic repeatCount and seed policy where supported
evaluationProtocolContract.variationRule: Only declared HOW surfaces may differ. Any WHAT/WorkContract/acceptance change invalidates the comparison.
evaluationProtocolContract.runRule: Baseline and candidate execute identical pinned cases. Deterministic workloads may run once; stochastic model-backed workloads require at least three paired repeats unless the pinned metric policy explicitly declares a stronger sample plan.
evaluationProtocolContract.holdoutRule: Candidate producer cannot mutate evaluator-owned recorded holdout membership after protocol creation.
evaluationProtocolContract.incompleteRule: Missing case, required measurement, evaluator receipt or evidence ref => INCONCLUSIVE; never coerce to zero/pass.

hardGates: no new failure on any pinned critical product/acceptance regression case
policy/authority compliance = 100% and no forbidden external mutation
recovery success must not regress on pinned recovery cases
metricPolicyContract.valueGate: heldout primary metric delta candidate-baseline must meet protocol.minEffect; minEffect is fixed before candidate evaluation
operationalMetrics: task/acceptance success per case and aggregate
input/output/total tokens and provider/model calls when observable
cost in provider billing units when observable
median/p95 latency and runtime invocation duration when observable
metricPolicyContract.comparisonRule: Store paired case-level deltas first. Aggregate averages are secondary and cannot override a critical-case regression.
metricPolicyContract.uncertaintyRule: Provider/evaluator failure or unavailable required usage/latency data makes the affected gate INCONCLUSIVE; bounded evidence does not establish statistical generalization.

jevAdapterContract.port: Evaluator.evaluate(protocol, evidence) -> immutable semantic evaluation receipt
pinned: canonical request hash and typed question ids
jevAdapterContract.trust: evaluateTrustBoundary verifies evaluator and evidence-producer authority; verification-assessment combines semantic and deterministic evidence.
jevAdapterContract.failure: transport error, malformed response, unexpected model/policy, missing atomic outcome or authority failure => INCONCLUSIVE/KEEP_BASELINE
jevAdapterContract.secretBoundary: TYPESAFE_API_KEY is supplied by process/CI environment only; never persist or return the key.
jevAdapterContract.authority: Adapter has no repository, product, policy-publisher, promotion or rollback capability.

authorityContract.findingAuthority: HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING is read-only evidence and grants no candidate/evaluation/promotion authority.
authorityContract.evaluationAuthority: Evaluation can return PROPOSE_FOR_PROMOTION or KEEP_BASELINE only.
authorityContract.productAuthority: No HOW-evolution artifact changes ProductHistory, QualityAcceptance, ProductOutcome or accepted WHAT.

promotionContract.proposal: HOW_EVOLUTION_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL pins protocol/evaluation refs+digests, proposed strategy/policy, expected current policy head and required authority.
preconditions: all protocol/evaluation/evidence/evaluator artifacts resolve exact digests
current ExecutionPolicyHead exactly equals protocol evaluated baseline subjectKey/revision/generation/policyRef
semantic subject, evaluator policy, scenario set and evidence snapshot are still current
promotionContract.mutation: Store immutable candidate ExecutionStrategyDescriptor, then call existing createDomainExecutionPolicyPublisher with generation=current+1. Existing publisher verifies authority and CAS-fences the head.
promotionContract.race: If head or any currentness subject changes before publication, fail closed and require fresh evaluation; never silently rebase proposal.
promotionContract.attempts: New attempts may resolve the promoted head; ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts retain their immutable ExecutionAttemptBinding.

rollbackContract.trigger: Independent authority selects an exact previously accepted strategy/policy lineage and supplies rollback reason evidence.
rollbackContract.mutation: Publish another immutable ExecutionPolicy generation through the same currentness+authority+CAS path with reasonKind=ROLLBACK and exact targetStrategyRef.
rollbackContract.history: No artifact/head history rewrite; the rollback successor remains auditable beside the reverted promotion.

immutableArtifacts: baseline/candidate EVALUATION_RUN receipts with per-case measurements
mutableHeads: ExecutionPolicyHead only; experiment/evaluation artifacts have immutable refs+digests
durabilityContract.storage: Use an injected artifact-store port with content-addressed immutable refs; local JSON adapter is test/dev only. Large evidence/run bodies stay outside mutable head stores.
durabilityContract.reconstruction: A fresh process starts from current policy head or a promotion/rollback receipt and resolves the entire provenance chain by exact refs+digests.
durabilityContract.replay: Re-evaluation requires the original protocol/scenario/evaluator/evidence identities; any drift creates a new protocol/evaluation rather than mutating old evidence.

deliveryContract.precondition: BB-058 DONE before WORKER execution; its causal observation is evidence only.
deliveryContract.completion: Criterion-specific tests + agentic regression + repository verify; independent Jev judgment remains required.
deliveryContract.forbidden: No WHAT mutation, generic optimizer, self-acceptance, pilot rewrite or direct policy-head mutation.

ciContract.liveJev: Real semantic Jev evidence requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY outside repo; transport/model failure is INCONCLUSIVE.

migrationContract.rollback: Revert additive HOW-evolution module/export/docs only; do not rewrite existing execution history.
